Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

[![Skeema](https://www.skeema.io/img/logo.png)](https://www.skeema.io)

# Skeema

Skeema is a tool for managing MySQL and MariaDB schema changes in a declarative fashion using pure SQL. The Skeema CLI tool allows you to:

* Export `CREATE TABLE` statements to the filesystem, for tracking in a Git repo
* Diff changes in the schema repo against live DBs to automatically generate DDL
* Manage multiple environments (e.g. dev, staging, prod) and keep them in sync with ease
* Configure use of online schema change tools, such as `pt-online-schema-change`, `gh-ost`, or `spirit`, for performing `ALTER TABLE`
* Apply configurable linter rules to proactively catch schema design problems and enforce company policies

Skeema supports a pull-request-based workflow for schema change submission, review, and execution. This permits your team to manage schema changes in exactly the same way as you manage code changes.

## Products and Downloads

This repo is the free open source Community edition of the Skeema command-line tool. The Community edition supports management of **tables** and **routines** (procs/funcs). Builds are provided for Linux and MacOS.

The paid Premium edition of the Skeema CLI adds support for managing **views**, **triggers**, and **events**. It also includes a native **Windows build**, built-in **SSH tunnel** functionality, **seed data** management, and many other improvements.

For download links and more information, visit [skeema.io](https://www.skeema.io/download/).

## Documentation

| --- | --- |
| [Installation](https://www.skeema.io/docs/install/) | How to install the Skeema CLI tool |

| [Features](https://www.skeema.io/docs/features/) | How Skeema interacts with each type of database object, and various feature-specific topics |
| [Configuration guide](https://www.skeema.io/docs/config/) | Option handling, config file format, and command-line option usage |
| [Command reference](https://www.skeema.io/docs/commands/) | Usage instructions for each command in the Skeema CLI |
| [Option reference](https://www.skeema.io/docs/options/) | Detailed information on every Skeema option |

| [Pipelines and automation](https://www.skeema.io/docs/automation/) | Integrating Skeema into automated workflows |
| [Recipes](https://www.skeema.io/docs/recipes/) | Using Skeema to achieve common schema management tasks |

		os.Exit(0)

	// Handle help command or flags

		if len(args) > 1 {
			// help <command>
			cmd := args[1]
			if help, ok := commands[cmd]; ok {
				fmt.Print(help)
				os.Exit(0)
			} else if cmd == "help" {
				fmt.Print(globalHelp)
				os.Exit(0)
			} else if cmd == "version" {

				os.Exit(0)

		os.Exit(0)

		}

		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {
		// If it looks like an option
		opt := strings.TrimLeft(args[0], "-")
		if !isValidGlobalOption(opt) {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "2026-04-29 06:45:02 [ERROR] CLI: Unknown option \"%s\"\n", opt)
			os.Exit(EXIT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
		}
		// If it's a valid option, just show help
		fmt.Print(globalHelp)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Unknown command
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "2026-04-29 06:45:01 [ERROR] Unknown command \"%s\"\n", args[0])
	os.Exit(EXIT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
}

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",
		"ignore-schema",
		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

	if cmd := args[0]; isCommand(cmd) {

		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Handle help command or flags

		if len(args) > 1 {
			// help <command>
			cmd := args[1]
			if help, ok := commands[cmd]; ok {

			} else if cmd == "help" {

	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {

		opt := strings.TrimLeft(args[0], "-")
		if !isValidGlobalOption(opt) {

		}
		// If it's a valid option, just show help
		fmt.Print(globalHelp)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Unknown command
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "2026-04-29 06:45:01 [ERROR] Unknown command \"%s\"\n", args[0])
	os.Exit(EXIT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
}

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",

		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(globalHelp)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Check for version and help flags
	if args[0] == "--version" || args[0] == "-version" {
		fmt.Printf("skeema version %s, commit %s, released %s\n", VERSION, COMMIT, RELEASED)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Handle help command or flags
	if args[0] == "help" || args[0] == "-?" || args[0] == "--help" || args[0] == "-help" {
		if len(args) > 1 {
			// help <command>
			cmd := args[1]
			if help, ok := commands[cmd]; ok {
				fmt.Print(help)
				os.Exit(0)
			} else if cmd == "help" {
				fmt.Print(globalHelp)
				os.Exit(0)
			} else if cmd == "version" {
				fmt.Printf("skeema version %s, commit %s, released %s\n", VERSION, COMMIT, RELEASED)
				os.Exit(0)
			} else {
				fmt.Print(globalHelp)
				os.Exit(0)
			}
		}
		fmt.Print(globalHelp)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Check if first arg is a command
	if cmd := args[0]; isCommand(cmd) {
		if help, ok := commands[cmd]; ok {
			fmt.Print(help)
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		if cmd == "version" {
			fmt.Printf("skeema version %s, commit %s, released %s\n", VERSION, COMMIT, RELEASED)
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		// For other commands, just show help (actual behavior would require DB connection)
		if cmd == "help" {
			if len(args) > 1 {
				if help, ok := commands[args[1]]; ok {
					fmt.Print(help)
					os.Exit(0)
				}
			}
			fmt.Print(globalHelp)
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		fmt.Print(globalHelp)
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {
		// If it looks like an option

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",
		"ignore-schema",
		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",
		"ignore-schema",
		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func handleHelpCommand(args []string) {
	if len(args) > 1 {
		// help <command>
		cmd := args[1]
		handleCommand(cmd, nil)
		return
	}
	printGlobalHelp()
}

func handleCommand(cmd string, args []string) {
	switch cmd {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
	case "help":
		if len(args) > 0 {
			handleCommand(args[0], nil)
		} else {
			printGlobalHelp()
		}
	case "init":
		printInitHelp()
	case "add-environment":
		printAddEnvironmentHelp()
	case "diff":
		printDiffHelp()
	case "format":
		printFormatHelp()
	case "lint":
		printLintHelp()
	case "pull":
		printPullHelp()
	case "push":
		printPushHelp()
	default:
		printGlobalHelp()
	}
}

		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {

		}
	}

	// Try to parse as option

	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {

	// Check if first arg is a command
	if isCommand(args[0]) {

		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Try to parse as option
	if strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {
		// If it looks like an option
		opt := strings.TrimLeft(args[0], "-")

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",
		"ignore-schema",
		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

			os.Exit(EXIT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
		}
		// If it's a valid option, just show help
		printGlobalHelp()
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	
	// Unknown command
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [ERROR] Unknown command \"%s\"\n", now, args[0])
	os.Exit(EXIT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
}

func handleHelpCommand(args []string) {
	if len(args) > 1 {
		// help <command>
		cmd := args[1]
		handleCommand(cmd, nil)
		return
	}
	printGlobalHelp()
}

func handleCommand(cmd string, args []string) {
	switch cmd {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
	case "help":
		if len(args) > 0 {
			handleCommand(args[0], nil)
		} else {
			printGlobalHelp()
		}
	case "init":
		printInitHelp()
	case "add-environment":
		printAddEnvironmentHelp()
	case "diff":
		printDiffHelp()
	case "format":
		printFormatHelp()
	case "lint":
		printLintHelp()
	case "pull":
		printPullHelp()
	case "push":
		printPushHelp()
	default:
		printGlobalHelp()
	}
}

func isCommand(cmd string) bool {
	validCommands := []string{"add-environment", "diff", "format", "help", "init", "lint", "pull", "push", "version"}
	for _, v := range validCommands {
		if v == cmd {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isValidGlobalOption(opt string) bool {
	validOptions := []string{
		"o", "connect-options",
		"debug",
		"?", "help",
		"H", "host-wrapper",
		"ignore-func",
		"ignore-proc",
		"ignore-schema",
		"ignore-table",
		"skip-my-cnf", "my-cnf",
		"p", "password",
		"ssl-mode",
		"u", "user",
		"version",
	}
	for _, v := range validOptions {
		if v == opt {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
